runtime_prompt_en:
Create a cinematic photorealistic photograph inside a coastal storm-surge command room at night. An unmistakably adult emergency planner derived from the supplied portrait’s oval face, brown eyes, and long dark wavy hair stands before a full-scale translucent digital counterpart with the same appearance and current pose. The linked pair is presented as a human digital twin system. She raises one arm over a live evacuation model; wearable biosensors send luminous data paths from her body into the counterpart, while a distinct return path carries an updated physiological forecast and rerouted flood simulation back to her wrist display. The counterpart mirrors her gesture but also visualizes internal state layers and predictive changes, making the bidirectional synchronization legible. Rain lashes panoramic windows, miniature coastal infrastructure glows below, and rotating emergency beacons add warm accents to cool volumetric light. Use a medium-wide diagonal composition from a slightly low off-axis camera, with shared beacon reflections and rain haze binding the physical woman, digital twin, sensor link, and changed simulation in one frame.

Avoid: cartoon style, 3D render look, body distortion, unrealistic hands, distorted fingers, over-processed retouching, fake-looking background, illustration look
